instruction.text: Select the sentence parts in the correct order to answer the question.

feedback.finish: Everyone’s personal boundaries are different and personal to them. Someone else might not feel comfortable with something that you think is okay.

atoms.finishSound: Personal boundaries are limits that we set to let people know what we are comfortable with.

feedback.finish: Everybody has their own personal boundaries and can change them whenever they want to.

instruction.text: Decide which people are allowed to have personal boundaries.
Select all the sentences that are examples of personal boundaries.

sound: I only want hugs from my family.
I don’t take part in gossiping.
I don’t keep secrets that could hurt someone.
I only take advice from people I trust.
I don’t want pictures of myself on the internet.

feedback.finish: Personal boundaries aren’t just physical, like not liking hugs, but also emotional, like not wanting to talk about certain things.

trainers.instruction: Decide if the statement is true or false.

atoms.a: Your mum should set personal boundaries for you.
Personal boundaries have to stay the same your whole life.
Personal boundaries can include physical and emotional things.
Other people should automatically know your personal boundaries.

feedback.end: It is your job to tell people what your boundaries are, and if they change. Otherwise, they won’t know if they have crossed them.
